title: Read a renderer route
responsibility: Extract branch, commit, category, entity and tab from an explorer route.

inputs.name: rendererPath.path
inputs.description: Slash-delimited path to inspect. The parser reads it only when the first two nonempty segments are `harness` and `branch`; every other path returns the default route.

outputs.name: rendererPath
outputs.description: A `RendererRoute` value with branch, commit, category, entity ID, and tab fields. For matching paths, branch is URI-decoded (empty if omitted), a `commit` segment provides the next raw segment, entity ID is URI-decoded, category defaults to `pages` unless the segment is recognized, and tab is the following raw segment; nonmatching paths return `pages` with the other fields null.

errors.name: URIError
errors.description: Thrown when `decodeURIComponent` receives malformed percent-encoding in the branch or entity ID segment of a matching route.
